from fractions import Fraction

import pytest

from recipekit.quantity import format_quantity, parse_quantity
from recipekit.scale import scale_recipe

PANCAKES = "Pancakes\nserves: 4\n1 1/2 cup flour\n2 tbsp sugar\n1 egg\n"


def test_parse_mixed_number():
    assert parse_quantity("1 1/2") == Fraction(3, 2)


def test_format_quantity():
    assert format_quantity(Fraction(7, 4)) == "1 3/4"
    assert format_quantity(Fraction(3, 4)) == "3/4"
    assert format_quantity(Fraction(2)) == "2"


def test_double_recipe():
    assert scale_recipe(PANCAKES, 8) == "Pancakes\nserves: 8\n3 cup flour\n4 tbsp sugar\n2 egg\n"


def test_lines_without_quantity_are_kept():
    assert scale_recipe("Soup\nserves: 2\nsalt to taste\n", 4) == "Soup\nserves: 4\nsalt to taste\n"


def test_rejects_too_many_servings():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        scale_recipe(PANCAKES, 61)

"""Scale a recipe to a different number of servings."""

from __future__ import annotations

from fractions import Fraction

from recipekit.quantity import format_quantity, split_line

MAX_SERVINGS = 60


def scale_line(line: str, factor: Fraction) -> str:
    """Multiply the quantity at the start of an ingredient line by factor."""
    parts = split_line(line)
    if parts is None:
        return line
    amount, rest = parts
    return f"{format_quantity(amount * factor)} {rest}"


def scale_recipe(text: str, servings: int) -> str:
    """A recipe's text (title, 'serves: N', ingredients) rescaled to servings."""
    if servings < 1:
        raise ValueError("servings must be at least 1")
    if servings > MAX_SERVINGS:
        raise ValueError(f"at most {MAX_SERVINGS} servings")
    title, header, *ingredients = text.splitlines()
    factor = Fraction(servings, int(header.removeprefix("serves: ")))
    lines = [title, f"serves: {servings}"] + [scale_line(line, factor) for line in ingredients]
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"


def scale_file(path: str, servings: int) -> str:
    """Read the recipe file at path and return it rescaled to servings."""
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        return scale_recipe(handle.read(), servings)
